set.body:
Outcome: DL5 order-independent condition. Map each unit without the surrounding recall (unit alone, or a fixed local window) as a separate condition in the same bundle and scorer; compare with full-context labels unit by unit.
Exit: stated agreement with full context and a recorded claim-boundary decision on whether order/chronology moves from not supported to experimental. Needs no new fields; can start after preview delivery 4. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl5-order-independent-condition.
set.title: [detail-mapping] DL5 order-independent mapping condition
